description: Labelled ground-truth corpus for retrieval-readiness-audit's RET-09 (positional fact interment) and RET-10 (chunk self-containment). Clean cases carry an empty expectation on purpose: they are the false-positive control.

cases.label: clean
cases.note: 880-word page whose four load-bearing figures are restated in the title, the h1, and a closing summary block — every value is anchored, so RET-09 stays silent despite clearing the 800-word gate.

cases.label: clean
cases.note: A 197-word page with two buried, unrestated values — well under the 800-word gate, so there is no meaningful 'middle' and RET-09 stays silent regardless.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: 864-word review page; four load-bearing figures (currency, a unit-bearing duration, a percentage, a weight) sit only in the middle of the document and are never restated anywhere.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: 857-word forum-thread page; a release date, a box-dimension spec, and a clamp-range measurement are buried mid-thread with no restatement, exercising the date and dimension extractors.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: 820-word buying-guide page with a decoy table near the top (color/finish only, not the buried figures) — presence of a table alone does not suppress the finding when the table doesn't contain the actual buried values.

cases.label: clean
cases.note: An FAQ page where every block repeats the brand name from its own Q&A heading — self-contained by construction, so RET-10 stays silent.

cases.label: clean
cases.note: Every block opens by naming its subject ('Zenith Metrics') explicitly instead of a pronoun or demonstrative — nothing is anaphoric, so RET-10 stays silent.

cases.label: clean
cases.note: Six short (<25-word) blocks, several genuinely opening with an unresolved pronoun — none are ever judged, since RET-10 only evaluates blocks of 25+ words.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: 223-word page; 4 of 5 blocks open with an unresolved pronoun/demonstrative/generic-definite reference and never name their own subject, well above the 25%/4-block thresholds.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: Same shape as the buried-pronoun-references case but with no headings anywhere on the page — exercises the confidence-to-high upgrade when no context-dependent block has any heading anchor.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: One self-referential 'This guide explains...' block (exempt, never counted) alongside four genuinely buried-reference blocks — proves the self-deixis exemption and the buried-reference detection coexist correctly on one page.
